title: Can you see how I learn? Human observers' inferences about Reinforcement Learning agents' learning processes
abstract: arXiv:2506.13583v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents often exhibit learning behaviors that are not intuitively interpretable by human observers, which can result in suboptimal feedback in collaborative teaching settings. Yet, how humans perceive and interpret RL agent's learning behavior is largely unknown. In a bottom-up approach with two experiments, this work provides a data-driven understanding of the factors of human observers' understanding of the agent's learning process. A novel, observation-based paradigm to directly assess human inferences about agent learning was developed. In an exploratory interview study (\textit{N}=9), we identify four core themes in human interpretations: Agent Goals, Knowledge, Decision Making, and Learning Mechanisms. A second confirmatory study (\textit{N}=34) applied an expanded version of the paradigm across two tasks (navigation/manipulation) and two RL algorithms (tabular/function approximation). Analyses

translated_title: 你能看到我是如何学习的吗？人类观察者对强化学习代理学习过程的推断
translated_abstract: 摘要：强化学习（RL）代理通常表现出人类观察者难以直觉理解的学习行为，这可能在协作教学环境中导致次优反馈。然而，人类如何感知和解读RL代理的学习行为在很大程度上仍属未知。通过自下而上的方法，本研究包含两项实验，提供了对人类观察者理解代理学习过程因素的数据驱动性认识。我们开发了一种新颖的、基于观察的范式，用于直接评估人类对代理学习的推断。在一项探索性访谈研究（N=9）中，我们识别出人类解释中的四个核心主题：代理目标、知识、决策制定和学习机制。第二项验证性研究（N=34）应用了扩展版本的范式，涵盖两个任务（导航/操作）和两种RL算法（表格/函数逼近）。分析...
tldr: 本研究通过开发一种基于观察的新范式，首次系统地揭示了人类观察者如何从目标、知识、决策和学习机制四个维度推断强化学习代理的学习过程，并验证了任务类型和算法类型对这些推断的影响。
en_tdlr: This study develops a novel observation-based paradigm to systematically reveal how human observers infer reinforcement learning agents' learning processes across four dimensions (goals, knowledge, decision-making, and learning mechanisms), and validates the effects of task types and algorithm types on these inferences.
